title: Answer: no position on physical measurement, observation is inference through a blanket

statements.text: The theory takes no position on measurement in physics. Any system with a Markov blanket knows external states only vicariously, by inference from its sensory states, which explains the problem of other minds. Feeling in others is known through their declarations, such as the words of patients during deep brain stimulation, within the limits of that problem.

sources.quote: the internal states of a self-organizing system can only ever register hidden external (not-system) states vicariously
they declare these subjective states in words
